sections.heading: 1. Test it properly
lines: ① Lie in your usual position for 10–15 min.
② Side sleeper? Hips and shoulders sink a little.
③ Read any trial period conditions carefully.
④ Check pillow height and a cooler room too.

sections.heading: 2. It might not be the mattress if…
lines: Night pain doesn't change with any position,
or comes with fever, weight loss or leg numbness.

slides.title:
Still waking up
stiff?
slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Koko is lying on showroom mattresses for 30 seconds each, hoping one will sort out her stiff mornings.

Research suggests medium-firm suits many people with back pain better than very firm, but comfort is personal. Side sleepers often like more give at the hips and shoulders; back sleepers usually like more support.

Lie on it for 10–15 minutes in your usual position, check any trial conditions, and remember pillow height, a cooler room, stress and daily activity all matter too.

Night pain that doesn't change with position, or pain with fever, weight loss or leg numbness, deserves an assessment. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio 🛏️
